fields.name: Footmuff buggy/stroller - Puffed - Olive Green / One Size
fields.description: This footmuff is perfect for your little one in the stroller or buggy. A real must-have for cold winter days. You can open the footmuff with the zipper, which moves both ways, so you can easily put your baby in and take them out again. The back of the footmuff has a practical hood, which you can fold around the head support of the buggy. This way, the footmuff will stay properly in place. The footmuff is water-repellent, so your baby will be warm and dry! Which colour will you get? This footmuff does not have a TOG rating, as it is designed to keep your little one warm on the go and not to be used as a sleeping bag.
